flags.why: 'Công việc dưng' is unnatural because this sense describes someone being idle, as in [ở dưng](https://vdict.com/d%C6%B0ng,3,0,0.html).
flags.fix: Dạo này ở dưng cũng buồn. = Being idle these days is rather boring.

flags.why: A basketful remains a normal quantity expression rather than an obsolete measure, as recorded in [this dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/th%C3%BAng).
flags.fix: Remove dated; gloss: a basketful (of grain).

flags.why: Learners today are much more likely to encounter the nickname for Russia than the adjective 'clumsy and silly', as illustrated by [current usage](https://baodanang.vn/ngay-ngo-ngo-ngac-ngo-3040752.html).
flags.fix: Put sense 2 first, followed by sense 3 and then sense 1.

flags.why: The nickname for Russia is established contemporary slang, so rare misrepresents its [current use](https://baodanang.vn/ngay-ngo-ngo-ngac-ngo-3040752.html).
The Russian-related use is established contemporary slang, also recorded without a rarity label in [Wiktionary](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/nga_ng%E1%BB%91).
The entry omits the common literal meaning of drawing, recorded in [this dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-v%E1%BA%BD%20v%E1%BB%9Di).
flags.fix: Add: to draw; to do some drawing. Example: Tôi thích vẽ vời lúc rảnh. = I like drawing in my free time.
